requirements.title: LLM-first research runtime entrypoint
acceptance_criteria: Research runtime is explicitly LLM-first and supports long-thinking multi-call execution rather than deterministic-only summarization.

requirements.title: Mission and scope ingestion contract
acceptance_criteria: Mission and scope documents are ingested before research call planning with deterministic source references.
Missing or malformed mission/scope inputs are surfaced as explicit research blockers with reason codes and fallback guidance.

requirements.title: Optional strategy packet ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Strategy artifacts are ingested when present and linked to research objectives without making strategy a hard runtime dependency.
When strategy is absent, research outputs explicitly mark assumptions and open questions instead of silently fabricating context.

requirements.title: Target project context normalization
acceptance_criteria: Target-project planning/runtime artifacts are normalized into a research context bundle with stable field names.
Normalization output is replay-stable across reruns for identical inputs and run identity.

requirements.title: Earth ecosystem context sweep
acceptance_criteria: Research sweep captures relevant cross-project context from Earth subprojects and links findings to source artifacts.
Sweep output records evidence references so downstream planner decisions can trace each cross-project claim.

requirements.title: Research objective extraction from mission intent
acceptance_criteria: Research objectives are derived from mission/scope intent and grouped into implementable tracks.
Each objective includes success criteria and why it matters for planner decomposition quality.

requirements.title: Milestone-to-research-track decomposition
acceptance_criteria: Project milestones are decomposed into research tracks with explicit milestone_id linkage.
Each track includes depth priority and expected artifact outputs for planner consumption.

requirements.title: Multi-call LLM orchestration plan
acceptance_criteria: Research executes through a multi-call LLM orchestration plan (discovery, synthesis, recommendation) with explicit call objectives.
Each call handoff records input refs and expected outputs so manager behavior is auditable.

requirements.title: LLM call trace and cost metadata ledger
acceptance_criteria: Every research LLM call emits trace rows with provider/model/profile, token/cost metadata, and evidence refs.
Call trace is written as append-only JSONL for replay diagnostics and budget auditing.

requirements.title: Deterministic run identity and artifact root bootstrap
acceptance_criteria: Each research run has deterministic run_id and stable artifact-root contracts under `research/current` and history snapshots.
Artifact bootstrap does not overwrite prior run history and records revision lineage.

requirements.title: External source query generation policy
acceptance_criteria: Query generation policy converts research objectives into concrete source queries and target domains.
Policy output includes recency expectations and authority preferences per objective.

requirements.title: Source fetch and extraction workflow
acceptance_criteria: External source retrieval and extraction produce normalized snippets, metadata, and raw source refs.
Fetch/extract workflow emits reason codes for unreachable or unsupported sources.

requirements.title: Source recency policy for unstable domains
acceptance_criteria: Research tracks unstable domains with explicit recency windows and stale-source handling.
Recency decisions are recorded in artifacts so planner can evaluate temporal risk.

requirements.title: Source quality and authority scoring
acceptance_criteria: Each source receives quality/authority scoring with transparent scoring factors.
Low-confidence sources are retained but clearly marked so recommendations do not treat them as high-confidence facts.

requirements.title: Citation normalization and deduplication
acceptance_criteria: Citations are normalized into canonical entries and deduplicated across topic packs.
Citation records preserve original URL, title, publisher, and retrieval timestamp.

requirements.title: Provenance metadata and licensing capture
acceptance_criteria: Provenance records include authorship/source metadata and usage/licensing notes where available.
Licensing uncertainty is explicitly flagged as an open risk instead of omitted.

requirements.title: Conflicting-source detection and reconciliation notes
acceptance_criteria: Conflicting sources are detected and summarized with explicit disagreement notes.
Research packet includes reconciliation guidance and confidence impact for conflicts.

requirements.title: Confidence scoring per claim and recommendation
acceptance_criteria: Claims and recommendations carry confidence scores tied to citation strength and source agreement.
Confidence scoring model is deterministic for identical normalized inputs.

requirements.title: Unsupported-claim rejection path
acceptance_criteria: Claims without sufficient evidence are rejected with deterministic reason codes.
Rejected claims are preserved in diagnostics so operators can inspect why they were excluded.

requirements.title: Open research gap capture from missing evidence
acceptance_criteria: Missing evidence and unresolved questions are emitted into open-gap artifacts with owner/action hints.
Gap artifacts are planner-consumable and linked to impacted milestone/topic IDs.

requirements.title: UI requirement detector and confidence output
acceptance_criteria: Research determines whether UI work is required and emits confidence with supporting evidence refs.
UI-required verdict is explicit in machine-readable output to drive downstream visual research tracks.

requirements.title: Screen inventory extraction for UI projects
acceptance_criteria: When UI is required, research extracts a concrete screen inventory with screen IDs and user goals.
Screen inventory includes source grounding from mission/scope/strategy text segments.

requirements.title: Per-screen research objective generation
acceptance_criteria: Each detected screen receives dedicated research objectives for layout, behavior, and interaction expectations.
Objectives include priority and dependency hints for planner sequencing.

requirements.title: Visual reference URL collection per screen
acceptance_criteria: For each UI screen/functionality, research collects multiple visual reference URLs with short rationale notes.
Reference collection avoids copyrighted redistribution and stores links/provenance only.

requirements.title: Visual reference provenance and usage notes
acceptance_criteria: Visual references include source attribution, retrieval timestamp, and usage caveats.
Usage notes identify what should be copied versus adapted versus avoided.

requirements.title: Visual pattern clustering and rationale summary
acceptance_criteria: Collected visual references are clustered into reusable design patterns with rationale.
Pattern summaries map to specific screens and functionality goals.

requirements.title: Accessibility requirement research pack
acceptance_criteria: Accessibility guidance covers semantics, navigation, input states, and assistive-tech compatibility concerns.
Output includes explicit implementation checkpoints planner can map into tasks.

requirements.title: Responsive behavior and breakpoint research pack
acceptance_criteria: Research produces responsive behavior guidance across mobile/tablet/desktop breakpoints.
Output includes concrete layout and interaction deltas by breakpoint class.

requirements.title: Interaction behavior reference collection
acceptance_criteria: Interaction references cover critical flows, state transitions, and feedback behaviors.
References are linked to screen IDs and planner-facing functional requirements.

requirements.title: UI risk and anti-pattern notes
acceptance_criteria: Research packet captures UI anti-patterns and likely failure modes for the target product type.
Each risk includes mitigation guidance and confidence level.

requirements.title: Architecture option matrix generation
acceptance_criteria: Research outputs architecture option matrices with pros/cons and applicability boundaries.
Matrix recommendations include prerequisites and tradeoff rationale.

requirements.title: Data storage and schema pattern research
acceptance_criteria: Data storage options and schema patterns are researched with workload-fit reasoning.
Research artifacts include migration and operational risk notes per option.

requirements.title: API contract and integration pattern research
acceptance_criteria: API and integration patterns are researched for interoperability, failure handling, and maintainability.
Pattern recommendations include compatibility constraints and testing implications.

requirements.title: Security and privacy control research
acceptance_criteria: Security/privacy controls are researched for the target domain with practical implementation guidance.
Outputs include minimum control baseline and escalation controls for higher-risk paths.

requirements.title: Compliance and regulatory consideration research
acceptance_criteria: Applicable compliance/regulatory considerations are identified and linked to impacted features.
Unknown compliance requirements are surfaced as explicit open questions with owner hints.

requirements.title: Performance and scalability reference research
acceptance_criteria: Performance/scalability references are gathered with context on workload assumptions.
Research includes measurable targets and instrumentation suggestions.

requirements.title: Observability and operability pattern research
acceptance_criteria: Observability/operability patterns cover logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and runbook expectations.
Output includes minimum production-operability checklist items for planning.

requirements.title: Infrastructure deployment option analysis
acceptance_criteria: Infrastructure deployment options are compared with operational complexity and reliability tradeoffs.
Analysis includes dependency on team skills, cost posture, and runtime constraints.

requirements.title: Cost model assumptions and sensitivity notes
acceptance_criteria: Research includes cost assumptions and sensitivity notes for key architectural choices.
Cost notes indicate uncertainty bands and main cost-risk drivers.

requirements.title: Dependency and supply-chain risk research
acceptance_criteria: Dependency/supply-chain risks are researched with mitigation and substitution guidance.
Risk output identifies high-risk dependencies requiring extra review before implementation.

requirements.title: Topic pack markdown artifact contract
acceptance_criteria: Every research topic outputs markdown with standardized sections and stable headings.
Markdown contract supports direct human review and planner references.

requirements.title: Topic pack json artifact contract
acceptance_criteria: Every research topic outputs JSON with stable machine-readable schema.
JSON contract includes ids, citations, scores, recommendations, and open risks.

requirements.title: Research index generation contract
acceptance_criteria: Research index aggregates topic packs, priorities, and coverage status for planner intake.
Index contract includes deterministic ordering and linkable topic IDs.

requirements.title: Milestone map artifact contract
acceptance_criteria: Milestone map links milestone IDs to research topics, confidence, and dependency notes.
Map output is machine-readable and replay-stable.

requirements.title: Recommendation priority scoring model
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation priority scoring reflects impact, feasibility, risk, and dependency readiness.
Scoring model output includes factor breakdown to avoid opaque ranking.

requirements.title: Implementation pathway section generation
acceptance_criteria: Research outputs implementation pathways with concrete sequencing guidance.
Pathway sections explicitly call out prerequisites and blocking assumptions.

requirements.title: Tradeoff and fallback section generation
acceptance_criteria: Topic packs include tradeoff and fallback sections for major recommendation branches.
Fallback guidance indicates trigger conditions for switching approach.

requirements.title: Cross-project dependency impact notes
acceptance_criteria: Research captures how target-project decisions affect or depend on other Earth projects.
Cross-project notes include concrete link refs for traceability.

requirements.title: Planner-context handoff packet generation
acceptance_criteria: Research builds planner-context packet with topic IDs, recommendation summaries, and evidence refs.
Handoff packet is directly consumable by planning flow without manual reshaping.

requirements.title: Topic-id cross-reference map for planner usage
acceptance_criteria: Research emits topic-id cross-reference maps suitable for embedding in planner rationale.
Map includes reverse lookup from milestone/functionality to topic IDs.

requirements.title: Research packet schema validator
acceptance_criteria: Research packet validator enforces schema and required-field contracts with deterministic diagnostics.
Invalid packets fail with explicit failing paths and reason codes.

requirements.title: Topic pack completeness validator
acceptance_criteria: Topic pack validator checks required sections (context/options/tradeoffs/recommendation/risks).
Completeness failures include actionable diagnostics suitable for automatic retry prompts.

requirements.title: Citation and provenance validator
acceptance_criteria: Citation/provenance validator checks URL presence, source metadata, and timestamp contracts.
Validator rejects unsupported citation shapes with deterministic diagnostics.

requirements.title: Visual reference validator for UI-required tracks
acceptance_criteria: When UI is required, validator enforces per-screen visual reference link minimums and provenance fields.
Validator reports missing or weak visual references by screen ID with severity.

requirements.title: Link health checker and stale-reference flags
acceptance_criteria: Link health checker marks dead/stale references and emits refresh-needed flags.
Stale-link findings are routed into open questions/risk outputs.

requirements.title: Replay determinism and idempotent rerun checks
acceptance_criteria: Research reruns with same inputs produce deterministic normalized outputs and stable IDs.
Idempotent checks detect and report non-deterministic field drift.

requirements.title: History snapshot and diff artifact generation
acceptance_criteria: Each run writes history snapshots and structured diffs against previous run outputs.
Diff artifacts highlight changed recommendations, confidence shifts, and new/removed references.

requirements.title: Failure reason-code contract for degraded runs
acceptance_criteria: Degraded runs emit deterministic reason-code contracts for partial outputs.
Degraded outputs remain consumable and clearly marked as partial/not-final where needed.

requirements.title: Planner ingestion smoke contract
acceptance_criteria: Planner-ingestion smoke verifies research packet can be consumed without schema or linkage breakage.
Smoke output includes concrete artifact refs demonstrating end-to-end ingestion path.

requirements.title: End-to-end autonomous research acceptance packet
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end run produces required research artifacts, validators, and planner handoff outputs under one run identity.
Acceptance packet captures summary, evidence refs, consumability verdict, and open risks for gate review.
